## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the trigger, intended user, bounded outcome, and changed skill paths.

## Evidence

List executed checks and observed results, failure cases, and unavailable checks. Link primary sources for changed mechanisms and explain redistribution rights for included third-party material.

## Checklist

- [ ] Skill follows `skills/<domain>/<slug>/` and the metadata/heading contract.
- [ ] Scope is distinct; references resolve and support files are needed.
- [ ] `node scripts/validate-skills.mjs` passes.
- [ ] Full diff manually checked for secrets, personal data, private URLs, and unsafe side effects.
- [ ] Attribution and required license notices retained; no unsupported compliance claims.
- [ ] No paid content, ZIP archives, packaging scripts, or distribution folders included.
